insignia.note: Field uniform: subdued shoulder boards (pogony) with stripes and five-pointed stars in protective (dark green) colour and no lumen (field boards have none). Narrow cross stripes: efreytor 1, mladshiy serzhant 2, serzhant 3; starshiy serzhant one wide cross stripe; starshina one wide stripe along the board (sources disagree: some give a wide and a narrow stripe); praporshchik 2 and starshiy praporshchik 3 small stars in a line along the board; leytenant 2 stars side by side, starshiy leytenant those 2 and one above on the middle line. Search extracts only (pages not opened); the 2011 wearing rules quoted are superseded.

note: Original colour choices (M7.5, docs/ASSETS.md): khaki-brown tones (made browner at the owner's review, 2026-11-13); a brighter protective green paint. Presentation only, outside the catalog.
